project_type: Next.js 16 App Router web app (El-Kema e-learning platform), React 19 + TypeScript, Tailwind v4 CSS-first, shadcn/ui new-york atoms + cva, next-intl (Arabic default/RTL + English), next-themes class dark mode, react-hook-form + zod, TanStack Query + Redux Toolkit for auth state.
build_system: npm scripts + Next.js (Turbopack). Windows/PowerShell — chain commands with ';' not '&&'. Tailwind v4 is CSS-first: tokens live in src/app/globals.css (:root + .dark + @theme inline), NO tailwind.config color extension. cacheComponents + partialPrefetching are enabled in next.config.ts.
test_framework: vitest (jsdom, @testing-library/react). Tests are co-located *.test.ts(x). Playwright exists for e2e but is not part of the gate.
verification_instructions: Run gates from repo root d:\devs\El-Kema-platform in this order, all must pass with 0 errors: 1) npm run typegen  2) npm run typecheck  3) npm run lint  4) npm run test  5) npm run build. After building each screen, use the figma power get_screenshot on the node id and compare to the built screen; iterate until no visible 1px drift. Commit to main only after all gates pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: npm run typegen (next typegen) generates .next/types used by typecheck (PageProps/LayoutProps helper types). Always run typegen before typecheck. No committed snapshots.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell: use ';' as the command separator, never '&&'. Download Figma assets with 'curl -L "<url>" -o public/auth/<name>.png' — the Figma mcp asset URLs expire in ~7 days and must NEVER be referenced at runtime (reference the downloaded file via next/image). The figma power (get_design_context / get_screenshot / get_variable_defs) uses fileKey y0eOLyKLtTHnJYzOW046WR.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: this is a modified Next.js — consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before using unfamiliar Next APIs; the nextjs-agent-rules block in AGENTS.md is generated by next dev, commit it with your work. Preserve existing auth logic/contracts. All copy via next-intl. RTL default; logical properties ONLY (ps/pe/ms/me/start/end — never left/right). Compose design-system components; do not re-style atoms inline. Keep messages ar/en key sets in sync.
key_patterns: Pages are RSC: 'const { locale } = await params; setRequestLocale(locale); const t = await getTranslations("auth");'. generateMetadata uses buildMetadata from @/lib/seo + routes from @/config/routes. Forms: 'use client' components using useForm + zodResolver(createXSchema(tv)) where tv=useTranslations('auth.validation'); mutations from ../hooks (useLogin/useRegister) handle toasts+redirect. cn is at @/lib/utils/cn. Link from @/lib/i18n/navigation. Tokens already present and reusable: --text-body (#52525a -> text-text-body), --radius-card-xl (24px -> rounded-card-xl), --muted (#f4f4f5), --muted-foreground (#a1a1aa). Spacing map: p-6=24, gap-12=48 (sections), gap-6=24 (sub-sections), gap-3=12 (heading/input-field gap).
directory_structure: src/app/[locale]/(auth)/{login,register,forgot-password}/page.tsx + shared layout.tsx (auth route group). src/features/auth/ holds the reusable form layer (schemas.ts zod, hooks.ts TanStack mutations, api.ts, types.ts, components/{login,register}-form.tsx, index.ts barrel). Design system: src/components/ui (atoms: Input, Button, Label, RadioGroup, Checkbox, Card...), src/components/molecules (PasswordToggle+usePasswordToggle, SelectableCard+SelectableCardGroup...), src/components/icons (lucide re-exports incl. EmailIcon=Mail, PasswordIcon=Lock, StudentIcon/TeacherIcon/ParentIcon; brand icons GoogleIcon/FacebookIcon/AppleIcon/LogoMark). Tokens in src/app/globals.css. Copy in messages/{ar,en}.json.
